draft.title: Taccuino del giorno · 30 agosto 2026
draft.excerpt: Quattro giovani talenti italiani in primo piano tra Serie A e i campionati minori: esordî e conferme nel weekend calcistico.
draft.excerptEn: Four young Italian talents take center stage across Serie A and lower divisions: debuts and confirmations in this weekend's football action.
draft.bodyIt:
**Davide Bartesaghi**
Il terzino rossonero trova spazio nelle formazioni ufficiali di Milan-Venezia, confermando la fiducia di Modric e affacciandosi ancora una volta al palcoscenico della massima serie. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwgFBVV95cUxOaWZQM1gwUGZPRmVtWWJRbm5HUEFTMExiR2NoTmdNcDI3YkFfMENwckotLWhMcEozUk1tNWdYTXJDR29Hb1B3RU9uNDZBOUxKd1RIXzk0SWQ0NE1kY3Z0YV84N2trWHhDNlZmTUE4bkNpcWhFd2Npclh4VFp1bUtMXzZCQmhZaGNqcFBzbEJQMV84aFI2dDVGVDdtYzV2SjNIY3A5dkRuTXhGbnVYeDladkVSXzRRY1o4YW9nczlwQjRsUQ?oc=5)

**Mattia Marello**
L'esterno nerazzurro firma un impatto positivo nel suo primo assaggio di calcio professionistico in Lega Pro, con Chivu e l'Inter che seguono da vicino la sua evoluzione. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxORVctdkljVDhxVkJtVFhURWttdk5VcEJFQW94Um9DaFV3Y2xVS3ZWZGZZeTRVOHNFTTJNV3NQaGJXSko4SzlYSW5hTmlBU2xIN3kyVWd5Z2NBdDRLRVQ3aXVUYUxqaWNIYTVpNDlBLXNFRkphSGhJTXREb3lQNjhwclJYcDBBdnpsZTU4?oc=5)

**Matteo Cocchi**
Il giovane centrale brilla in Padova-Ascoli e firma un esordio di assoluto valore, tanto da meritarsi i titoli di MVP dei giornali specializzati prima di un'ingenuità che macchia altrimenti una prestazione eccellente. [fonte](https://news.google.?oc=5)

**Nicolò Calabrese**
Il giovane difensore veronese debutta con l'Hellas a Padova, portando in campo l'esperienza e le speranze di una provincia che segue con attenzione i suoi progressi. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxQd2EyNHVoTEs4TlJ0ZElRaTJ5T1VMckpZMjlIWWF2SlpaeGxxbm01eWl0bkNFcm1LSDl2MHNCOHAtMTFqajkxRkJ2aDZEdjFGUmhqQmVMMFg5TE9mTndaR05USHZkQVVTNGhXY0Q5S3RaSTJoa2szTzV2anRaWW9mVmRvY3ZrUzI3QXVz?oc=5)

Una giornata che racconta il percorso di giovani talenti tra le spalle e il presente della competizione calcistica italiana.
draft.bodyEn:
**Davide Bartesaghi**
The Rossoneri fullback secures a spot in the starting lineup for Milan-Venezia, earning continued trust and taking another step on Serie A's biggest stage. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwgFBVV95cUxOaWZQM1gwUGZPRmVtWWJRbm5HUEFTMExiR2NoTmdNcDI3YkFfMENwckotLWhMcEozUk1tNWdYTXJDR29Hb1B3RU9uNDZBOUxKd1RIXzk0SWQ0NE1kY3Z0YV84N2trWHhDNlZmTUE4bkNpcWhFd2Npclh4VFp1bUtMXzZCQmhZaGNqcFBzbEJQMV84aFI2dDVGVDdtYzV2SjNIY3A5dkRuTXhGbnVYeDladkVSXzRRY1o4YW9nczlwQjRsUQ?oc=5)

**Mattia Marello**
The Nerazzurri winger makes a strong impression on his first taste of professional football in Serie C, with Chivu and Inter monitoring his development closely. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxORVctdkljVDhxVkJtVFhURWttdk5VcEJFQW94Um9DaFV3Y2xVS3ZWZGZZeTRVOHNFTTJNV3NQaGJXSko4SzlYSW5hTmlBU2xIN3kyVWd5Z2NBdDRLRVQ3aXVUYUxqaWNIYTVpNDlBLXNFRkphSGhJTXREb3lQNjhwclJYcDBBdnpsZTU4?oc=5)

**Matteo Cocchi**
The young center-back shines in Padova-Ascoli and delivers an outstanding debut performance, earning MVP status from the press before a careless moment that slightly tarnished an otherwise excellent display. [source](https://news.google.?oc=5)

**Nicolò Calabrese**
The young Verona defender makes his debut with the Gialloblu at Padova, bringing talent and promise to a region that closely follows his progression. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxQd2EyNHVoTEs4TlJ0ZElRaTJ5T1VMckpZMjlIWWF2SlpaeGxxbm01eWl0bkNFcm1LSDl2MHNCOHAtMTFqajkxRkJ2aDZEdjFGUmhqQmVMMFg5TE9mTndaR05USHZkQVVTNGhXY0Q5S3RaSTJoa2szTzV2anRaWW9mVmRvY3ZrUzI3QXVz?oc=5)

A day that chronicles the journey of young talents between aspiration and the reality of Italian football competition.
